description:
Read RS3 GE catalogue metadata. Do not use this for item prices: use get_item_details. For entries use browse_items; for Wiki categories use list_wiki_category_members.

- view=status reports configuration date/age, not price freshness.
- view=categories lists all 44 built-in IDs; duplicate names identify separate groups.
- view=category_counts requires category 0-43, e.g. 24 for high-level melee weapons. Category 0 is one Miscellaneous group, not an all-groups sentinel. The response counts entries by starting letter (# means numbers), not stock or offers.

category is rejected outside category_counts; it cannot filter the full list. categories needs no network; other views make one uncached Jagex read. No credentials required. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; honor 429 Retry-After.

view.description: Metadata view; omit for the original configuration status result

name: get_ge_info

configurationAgeDays.description: UTC calendar days since configuration update; negative for a future upstream date

fetchedAt.description: Server retrieval time, not a price update timestamp

lastConfigUpdateDate.description: Configuration UTC date derived from RuneDay

lastConfigUpdateRuneday.description: Upstream RuneDay counter for catalogue configuration update

priceFreshness.description: Configuration metadata does not report item-price freshness

categories.description: All 44 category references, sorted by ID

items.description: Number of catalogue items in this letter group

title: Read GE Catalogue Metadata
